platform: Assumed on-chip research stack adapted from Toolkit Open GPDK180 sample; no foundry qualification
solver: ADS Momentum 2027 full-wave, verified runtime; actual solve checkout required
generator: RFIC Inductor Toolkit Open 2.3.1 single-turn artwork and diameter synthesis

geometry.family: single-turn octagonal loop, no stacked metal
geometry.rules_classification: explicit research assumptions adopted from open example, not DRC certification
geometry.center_tap: omit with documented toolkit artwork option if supported; otherwise retain as open auxiliary port with original network

return.conductor: finite Metal1 rectangular frame, conductivity 24.0509 MS/m, thickness 0.53 um
return.contact: explicit reference pin on lower frame; all signal port negatives connect to this physical conductor
return.backside: open; remove sample perfect infinite ground
return.environment: laterally infinite stratified dielectric/substrate; air above and below; no enclosure or nearby metal
return.sensitivity: frame size factors 1.5 and 2.2; reference pin/contact sensitivity at unchanged signal planes

stack.source: Toolkit Open Inductor_Generic_Layers_IC_lib GPDK180.subst and materials.matdb
stack.classification: open example values adopted as explicit research assumptions; no measured 65 GHz validation
stack.loss_tangent_classification: explicit research assumption replacing sample lossless oxides
stack.oxide1_permittivity_classification: 4.2 is an explicit research assumption; validate exported solver values against this contract
stack.dispersion: constant parameters within mathematical 0-200 GHz research domain; fabrication/material accuracy unqualified
stack.conductor_treatment: finite thickness and bulk conductivity with skin/proximity loss; compare available thick conductor model

ports.additional: retain center tap if present and set its current to zero for extraction
ports.current_direction: into signal conductor, out through common finite frame reference
ports.reference_planes: outer end of both toolkit 5 um feed extensions; no pads and no lead removal
ports.calibration: uncalibrated internal/point ports baseline; sensitivity documented separately
ports.extraction: Zd=Z11+Z22-Z12-Z21; I1=I,I2=-I,Icm=0; all auxiliary signal currents zero

criteria.uncertainty: combine observed numerical sensitivities conservatively; uncovered intervals or unresolved checks give INDETERMINATE

frequency_protocol.final_GHz: 0.01,0.1,1, then 5:1:100 and 105:5:200; refine crossings/extrema and independently solve 65/80
frequency_protocol.low_frequency: geometry/conductivity DCR with declared return contribution and RF low-frequency comparison; RF point is not DC solve

budget.stop: qualified target with no required gaps, geometry budget exhausted, or demonstrated unavailable essential solver capability

decisions.model_use: conditional diagnostic until single-device numerical checks and separate parent compatibility review
